newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Reuters launches new service in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Reuters launches new service in Asia.

text.p: Reuters Holdings plc said on Monday Singapore would be the starting point of an Asia-wide launch of a new tool based on Internet technology for clients to access the company's global news and information database.
Reuters said in a statement Reuters Business Briefing (RBB) had been redesigned to make it Internet and intranet compatible.

"Intranets are likely to become as accepted an aspect of corporate life as the personal computer and we want to be part of this dynamic development," Mark Trasenster, managing director of Reuters Business Information Projects Asia (BIP Asia), said in the statement.
Launched originally in 1994, RBB is an on-line database of current and archive news generated by Reuters' 1,940 jouranlists worldwide, plus material from 4,000 different sources.
The new Internet-friendly RBB product broadens the delivery mechanism for Reuters services, important as more corporations were choosing Internet-based options to source information, Trasenster said.
He said it would use the multicast techology of Reuters subsidiary TIBCO.
The new RBB will have four service levels from simple headlines delivered at pre-determined intervals to direct access to the full RBB 10-year archive.
The new product had the potential to triple RBB sales, Reuters said.
